skills.description: 轻量级 WebApp 多智能体协作框架，单个技能文件即包含完整的 7 Agent 角色定义、11 状态机流转规则、 团队创建与分派逻辑。适用于快速搭建多 Agent 协作项目，无需依赖其他文件。 触发词：mini-harness、轻量框架、快速搭建、初始化协作、建团队、build-team、多 agent 协作。
skills.description_zh:
>#Mini-Harness 使用说明
##是什么
Mini-Harness 是一个轻量级多智能体协作框架，一个 SKILL.md 文件就包含完整的 7 Agent 角色 + 11 状态工作流 + 分派规则。装上就能在任何 WorkBuddy 项目里用，不依赖其他文件。

##使用方法
安装后在 CodeBuddy/Workbuddy 对话中输入触发词即可：
/mini-harness

##框架核心

###7 个 Agent 角色
PM / Planner / Coder / Reviewer / Tester / Evaluator / Deployer

###11 状态工作流
IDEA → PLAN → TEST-PLAN → CODE → REVIEW → DEPLOY-TEST → TEST-RUN → EVAL → DEPLOY-PROD → MONITOR → ARCHIVE

###TDD 驱动
Coder 按 RED→GREEN→REFACTOR 循环，测试覆盖率≥80%

###6 维 Review
正确性 / 可读性 / 可测性 / 性能 / 安全 / 风格，任一 BLOCK 则回退

##质量门禁
EVAL 评分 ≥80 PASS / 60-79 WARN / <60 BLOCK

##关键约束
Review 不可跳过：CODE 之后必须经过 REVIEW
默认测试环境：deploy 命令默认部署到测试环境，--prod 需 PM 审批
E2E 禁止 mock 后端：TEST-RUN 阶段必须用真实后端
Team Lead 只分派不执行：主 Agent 不写代码、不跑测试、不亲自部署
团队就绪后等用户：7 个 Agent 创建完成后必须停下来，等用户输入需求
##适用场景
快速搭建多 Agent 协作开发项目
需要 TDD + Review + 自动部署的标准化流程
skills.name: mini-harness

Covers 5 use cases: ① Establishing a Meditation Practice — learn proper posture, breathing, and how to sit with a clear mind ("How to meditate" "My mind won't stop racing" "How to sit in zazen") ② Cultivating Beginner's Mind — approach every experience with openness, curiosity, and no preconceptions ("How to stay curious" "I feel like I know enough already" "How to see things fresh") ③ Working with Thoughts — handle mind-wandering, emotional turbulence, and mental noise with compassion ("My mind is too busy" "How to stop thinking" "I get distracted during meditation") ④ Bringing Zen into Daily Life — practice mindfulness in ordinary activities: eating, walking, working, speaking ("How to be mindful in daily life" "Zen at work" "How to practice off the cushion") ⑤ Understanding Non-Attachment — let go of expectations, goals, and the need to "get somewhere" in practice ("Am I doing this right" "I'm not making progress" "How to let go of attachment")  Trigger when users say: "Zen meditation" "How to meditate" "Beginner's mind" "Shunryu Suzuki" "Zazen" "Mindfulness" "Zen Buddhism" "How to be present" "Meditation for beginners" "Stop overthinking" "Let go of attachment" "Mushotoku" "Just sitting" "Buddhist meditation" "Zen practice" or mention: Shunryu Suzuki / Zen Mind / Beginner's Mind / zazen / meditation / Zen / Buddhism / mindfulness / beginner's mind / emptiness / suchness.  Also triggers when the user says they just installed this skill or doesn't know how to start — the AI MUST proactively present the Quick Start guide below.  Related skills: the-power-of-now (presence and mindfulness), be-here-now (spiritual awakening), the-miracle-of-mindfulness (mindful living), the-happiness-advantage (positive psychology), radical-happy (Buddhist happiness).
